UK
Consular help: Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in London, United Kingdom.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Sarajevo):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
From December 17, 2024, the Government of the United Kingdom introduced electronic visas (eVisas), which from January 2025, will completely replace documents that were used as proof of a residence permit for more than six months, such as a biometric residence permit (BRP), a visa sticker or a stamp in a travel document, as well as a biometric residence card (BRC).Citizens of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
